scope: Four existing original practice MCQs 15–18; 4 keys + 12 distractors

questions.key_claim: PESA section 4(e)(i): Gram Sabha approval of village-level development plans in Scheduled Areas

distractors.A: FRA section 3 concerns recognised forest rights, not PESA project approval

questions.caveat: PESA is not applicable to every village; no Telangana village-level implementation record inspected

questions.key_claim: FRA 2006 recognises qualifying community grazing and community forest resource rights

distractors.A: PESA concerns Scheduled Area Panchayat governance
distractors.C: PM-JANMAN is development mission, not forest title

questions.caveat: Gram Sabha initiation does not mean automatic title approval

questions.key_claim: PM-JANMAN targets PVTG families and habitations with multi-sector interventions

distractors.B: EMRS is education-focused rather than multi-sector habitation saturation
distractors.D: NSAP is social assistance, not PVTG habitation infrastructure

questions.caveat: Mission targets do not prove completed coverage

questions.key_claim: Article 342A(3) recognises State/UT lists potentially different from Central OBC List

distractors.A: State inclusion does not automatically amend Central List
distractors.C: Central List amendments require formal constitutional process, not district census discretion

questions.caveat: No individual Telangana community entry or reservation eligibility independently established
